lead.headline: Maye I touch your TDs? came all the way back
lead.dek: At the last update, the 2-6 team was getting buried by Poochinski and its two quarterbacks had barely scored. After the late games it leads 148.14 to 144.3. Poochinski is still 76.8% to win, because the whole matchup now lives in one Sunday night game.
lead.pull: Maye I touch your TDs? 148.14, Poochinski 144.3. Three players left, one stadium.
body: I’ve covered Maye I touch your TDs? all season, and at the last update I had this one filed under blowouts. Poochinski was miles ahead, and this team’s quarterbacks were barely on the board. Then the late window happened. Maye I touch your TDs? walked out of it leading the 6-2 team 148.14 to 144.3.

This is how a two-quarterback league is supposed to work. Brock Purdy finished at 26.28. Drake Maye finished at 21.26. Both slots paid. Christian Watson went for 30.1 at flex against a 15.92 projection, Amon-Ra St. Brown added 16.6, Harold Fannin Jr. 12.2, and the Cleveland defense 11.0. Ten starters are final, and they’re ahead of the first-place team.

Poochinski, meanwhile, barely moved in the late window. Its damage was already done: CeeDee Lamb 33.5, Javonte Williams 22.4, Dak Prescott 19.5, Chris Olave 16.8. The disappointment was Jahmyr Gibbs, 13.4 against a 25.69 projection, with Sam LaPorta at 7.2.

Here’s why the lead isn’t a win yet. Poochinski has two players left: Caleb Williams, projected for 18.71, and Luther Burden III, at 14.44. That’s 33.15 to come. Maye I touch your TDs? has one: Bucky Irving, at 17.62. All three play in the same game, Sunday night at 5:20 PM Pacific. Irving on one side, a Williams-to-Burden stack on the other. The live projection is 177.45 to 165.76, Poochinski, and the win odds say 76.8%.

One thing that will haunt this front office if it goes wrong: Breece Hall scored 11.7 on the bench while Tyler Allgeier scored 6.6 at running back. In a game this close, that’s a Tuesday story waiting to happen. My pick follows the math, Poochinski. But for the first time all week, Maye I touch your TDs? is the one being chased.

quick_hits.headline: DJ Moore hasn’t even played yet
quick_hits.body: George Pickens was Out and started at receiver for deeboliciouskins, and that slot is a locked 0.0. DJ Moore, projected for 12.78, sits on the bench and doesn’t play until Monday. The live projection has deeboliciouskins short of Santa Clara’s Finest by 8.11. Do that math once and then stop, because it hurts.

quick_hits.headline: Seven R.A.T.S. starters, one game
quick_hits.body: Tampa Bay at Chicago decides most of this league. Poochinski has Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III, Maye I touch your TDs? has Bucky Irving, deeboliciouskins has D’Andre Swift, Santa Clara’s Finest has Colston Loveland, Bad things has the Chicago defense and Big Stric Energy has its kicker, Chase McLaughlin. Three matchups are still live tonight, and that game touches all of them.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom hands the 7-1 team a loss
quick_hits.body: It’s over: Cherry Blossom 178.18, AB81 120.56. Puka Nacua scored 35.0, Christian McCaffrey 22.7, Brock Bowers 22.3, Tee Higgins 20.2, and that’s the week’s top score so far; nobody’s live projection catches it. It even left Bo Nix’s 16.68 on the bench while Jared Goff scored 6.3. AB81’s best was its kicker, Cam Little, at 17.0.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things benched 36.36 at quarterback
quick_hits.body: C.J. Stroud scored 36.36 on the Bad things bench, Tyler Shough added 19.7 there, and Malik Willis started and scored 4.82. It won’t matter: Matthew Golden’s 32.4 and Bijan Robinson’s 26.7 have Bad things up 141.56 to 90.18 and 92.8% to win. Lucky this time.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy needs a miracle Monday
quick_hits.body: Jordan Love scored 36.18, and nothing else on this roster kept pace. Big Stric Energy trails 141.56 to 90.18 with Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson on Monday and Chase McLaughlin tonight. The live projection is 164.23 to 135.99, it’s 7.2% to win, and its playoff odds sit at 29.1%.

w9-m1.headline: Bad things has this one in hand
w9-m1.blurb: 141.56 to 90.18. Big Stric Energy has three left, Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson on Monday and Chase McLaughlin tonight; Bad things has James Cook III on Monday and the Chicago defense tonight. 164.23 to 135.99 projected. Bad things, 92.8%.

w9-m2.headline: Swift versus Loveland, and a locked zero
w9-m2.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest leads 130.64 to 114.54, with one player left each, both tonight: Colston Loveland, 11.0 projected, against D’Andre Swift, 18.99. The live projection is 141.64 to 133.53. The Finest, 72.1%, with Lamar Jackson’s 0.0 still in its lineup.

w9-m3.headline: The underdog leads. The favorite has two left.
w9-m3.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? 148.14, Poochinski 144.3. Bucky Irving against Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III, all in the same game tonight. 177.45 to 165.76 projected. Poochinski, 76.8%.

w9-m4.headline: Final: Cherry Blossom 178.18, AB81 120.56
w9-m4.blurb: Every starter is done. Puka Nacua’s 35.0 led a lineup with six players over 17, and the 7-1 team takes its second loss.

w9-r7-s6.headline: The Finest’s TE call now decides a game
w9-r7-s6.blurb: Hunter Henry sat and scored 6.5 on the bench. Colston Loveland, 11.0 projected, took the spot and plays tonight. He’s the only player Santa Clara’s Finest has left.

w9-r7-s4.headline: The Finest’s WR call: Boston in, 15.8
w9-r7-s4.blurb: Garrett Wilson was Out. Denzel Boston, projected for 10.75, took the spot and beat it. Part of why the 1-7 team still leads.

w9-r2-s4.headline: Poochinski’s WR call: Olave in, 16.8
w9-r2-s4.blurb: Chris Olave over Chris Godwin Jr. Olave scored 16.8. Godwin, on the bench, plays tonight.

w9-r6-s0.headline: deeboliciouskins’ QB call: Mahomes, 16.48
w9-r6-s0.blurb: Kyler Murray sat, Patrick Mahomes started and scored 16.48. That one was handled. The receiver slot was not.

alert_notes.6: George Pickens started at receiver and his team played without him. The slot is locked at 0.0, DJ Moore, 12.78 projected, is on the bench and plays Monday, and deeboliciouskins trails 130.64 to 114.54.
alert_notes.7: Lamar Jackson started at quarterback and his team played without him on Thursday. That 0.0 is locked, and the Finest leads 130.64 to 114.54 anyway.
